name: Henderson Far East Income Limited
quirks: Jersey-domiciled closed-end investment trust (LSE primary HFEL.L, NZX secondary HFL.NZ) - NOT an operating company: no FCF/EBITDA/OperatingIncome, valued on NAV + exit premium/discount at cost of equity.
Fiscal year ends 31 August; half-years end 28/29 February.
Reports in GBP (£'000); NAV, dividends and per-share returns are in PENCE. NZX quote is NZD - never divide the NZD price by a pence NAV.
Income statement is AIC SORP revenue/capital/total split: NetIncome = TOTAL return; revenue return is the recurring distributable earnings.
NAV/share fell 337.76p (FY2016) to 223.32p (FY2025), -4.5%/yr, while DPS rose every year 20.00p to 24.90p; dividend cover ~1.0x (0.864x FY2023).
